title: Three people killed in plane crash in Arizona’s Grand Canyon national park
summary_full: Wreckage of Piper Comanche aircraft was found on Monday after going missing in park’s North Rim areaThree people were killed in a plane crash near the northern rim of Grand Canyon national park in Arizona, the federal park service said on Monday.The Grand Canyon regional communications center received a report of a missing Piper Comanche aircraft at about 11.30pm on Sunday, a statement from officials said. The plane was last known to be in the Basin area of the park’s North Rim, a higher-elevation and less-visited section of the park. Continue reading...
